messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] sustained error spike for tenant 'NebulaCorp' on dedicated-pool-3 (region: eu-central-1). 5xx > 20% over 4m. Severity: Sev2. Auto-escalating to oncall.
Ivy K.: ACK. jumping on triage. creating a bridge if needed.
Diego M.: looking at proxy metrics. 502s coming back from runtime layer, code path model-serving. opening logs now.
Priya R.: pinging CSM. NebulaCorp is enterprise, they require an update within 30m and phone bridge if impact persists. @Tessa J. fyi.
Tessa J.: on it. asking customer if they want bridge; also checking their contract SLA window.
Connor L.: preliminary: docker OOMs on worker pods, and host kernel logs show repeated GPU driver hangs. suspiciously timed with a security patch we rolled this morning.
Ivy K.: can we move NebulaCorp traffic off the affected pool? prefer isolation to avoid broader impact.
deploy-bot: creating route override: move tenant NebulaCorp to warm-pool-2 (fallback) — change queued.
deploy-bot: route override applied (cfg: move-189998-1). Traffic redirecting.
Diego M.: after redirect, 502 rate fell to ~6% but some requests still failing (long tails). collecting traces.
Priya R.: customer wants a short public statement now: sent at 12:52: "We are aware of elevated errors for your workspace. We have isolated your traffic and are investigating. We will follow up with timeline and RCA."
Ivy K.: thumbs up. starting host-level captures: `dmesg`, `nvidia-smi -q`, container core dumps. will upload to internal bucket.
Connor L.: note: autoscaler did not spin up more capacity during spike; looks like scale-up was blocked by image-puller timeouts because of registry throttling. that's an upstream contributor.
Tessa J.: ticket with registry team opened. registry team says a rate-limit config was applied at 11:45 which may have impacted concurrent node startups.
Priya R.: asked customer if they'd like a conference bridge. they requested a brief call only if we expect >45m impact.
Ivy K.: mitigation plan: 1) divert NebulaCorp to warm-pool-2 (done) 2) temporarily increase request timeout and add retry at proxy for idempotent calls 3) cordon affected hosts and reboot after collecting dumps 4) rollback today's driver/security patch if correlation holds.
Diego M.: starting to collect correlation matrix: driver update at 11:40 -> registry rate-limits at 11:45 -> first autoscaler failures 11:50 -> OOMs 11:53 -> customer impact 11:56. will attach timeline.
deploy-bot: cordon node gpu-eu-3 and schedule reboot (job-id: cordon-189998).
Connor L.: uploading core dumps to `s3://redwood-incidents/nebulacorp/1899987654/`. security/legal hold: do not share externally until scrubbed.
LegalBot: Legal acknowledges. require PII scrub checklist before any external sharing. Will need customer NDA amendment for raw dumps.
Ivy K.: handoff: I'm stepping off in 25m; Diego please take lead. Diego can you draft initial RCA outline including customer-facing executive blurb?
Diego M.: taking lead. I'll post RCA v0.1 to `docs/incidents/1899987654-rca-draft.md` and ping for reviews. timeline + suspected root cause + mitigations.
Priya R.: customer ops: NebulaCorp wants estimated credits and whether this will violate SLA. I'll ask finance for a provisional pro-rata credit if impact >30m.
Tessa J.: finance pinged. provisional credit policy: if customer experiences >0.1% availability breach in a month, standard is X% pro-rata. we'll calculate precisely once duration known.
Diego M.: testing rollback of today's security-driver on a single host. so far stable for 7m. if stable, roll across pool.
Ivy K.: note to docs: add per-tenant circuit-breaker runbook. we had to manually redirect traffic; should be automated with one-click isolation.
Connor L.: registry team confirmed they pushed a change to limit concurrent pulls at scale. we've asked them to revert the rate-limit. their rollback done at 12:10.
deploy-bot: driver-rollback job initiated (job-id: rollback-189998). rolling across affected hosts.
Diego M.: after rollback and redirects, error rate for NebulaCorp down to 1.8% at 12:34. continuing to monitor. requesting to lift throttles after 20m stability.
Priya R.: customer update sent at 12:35: "We've isolated your workload to a warm pool and applied fixes; errors are trending down. We'll share RCA and remediation timeline by EOD and propose credits if applicable."
LegalBot: confirmed we can share redacted crash artifacts under existing NDA. will provide redaction checklist to engineering.
Ivy K.: PD ticket created PD-48012. linking incident artifacts and owners. assignees: diego.m, priya.r, connor.l.
Diego M.: RCA v0.1 posted internally: summary, timeline, root cause hypothesis (concurrent registry rate-limits + driver regression + autoscaler sensitivity), mitigation steps, actions. requesting review by end of day.
Tessa J.: drafting exec note to send to customer CTO after we finalize numbers. will include apology, impact window, mitigations, and proposed credits.
Priya R.: customer requested bridge at 14:00 tomorrow for deeper technical walkthrough. scheduling it now.
Connor L.: action items being tracked: (1) add registry pull backoff + caching for scale-ups (2) add pre-deploy driver mem regression test (3) implement per-tenant isolation automation (4) update SLA breach alerts and credit calc automation.
Diego M.: attaching artifacts: logs `s3://redwood-logs/nebulacorp/189998/*`, RCA draft `docs/incidents/1899987654-rca-draft.md`, PD ticket PD-48012.
incident-bot: Incident marked STABLE at 12:45 UTC. severity downgraded to Sev3 for follow-up.
Ivy K.: thanks everyone. closing live bridge. follow-ups will continue in #incidents and #customer-success for the comms. good recovery :raised_hands:
